imageStudio.title: AI Image & Photography Studio
imageStudio.subtitle: Upload smartphone product photos for instant AI evaluation on lighting, background contrast, and marketplace listing readiness.
imageStudio.dragDrop: Drag and drop your craft image here, or click to browse files
imageStudio.supportedFormats: Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP up to 10MB
imageStudio.tip1: Shoot in natural morning daylight near a window to reveal genuine colors.
imageStudio.tip2: Place a plain white chart paper or cotton cloth underneath for clean contrast.
imageStudio.tip3: Take at least 1 close-up shot showing fine texture, weave, or brushwork.
